title: SAP S/4HANA released CDS views, the universal journal: journal entries and their line items (I_JournalEntry, I_JournalEntryItem, I_GLAccountLineItemRawData)
status_note: Proposed, not tested on a customer. Every view, key, association and amount below is taken from public documentation and written in our own words; none of it has been checked against an SAP system by this project, and where a page could not be opened the source says so. validate_plan checks it against your rows. A pack is a sourced suggestion, not proof.

tables.name: I_JOURNAL_ENTRY
tables.note: AccountingDocument is unique only within company code and fiscal year: all three are needed.

tables.name: I_JOURNAL_ENTRY_ITEM
tables.en: Journal entry items of the universal journal (CDS view)

corresponds_to.note: One row per ACDOCA row and ledger: SourceLedger is RLDNR, LedgerGLLineItem is DOCLN, CompanyCode RBUKRS, FiscalYear GJAHR, AccountingDocument BELNR.

tables.key_note: The ledger is part of the key: one posting has a line per ledger. Ledger and SourceLedger are equal for a standard ledger; for an extension ledger, Ledger is the extension ledger and SourceLedger the ledger the line was read from.
tables.note: Amounts are signed. Filter on one Ledger before summing, or each posting counts once per ledger.

tables.name: I_GL_ACCOUNT_LINE_ITEM_RAW_DATA
tables.en: G/L account line items, raw data for extraction (CDS view)

corresponds_to.note: One row per ACDOCA row, without the authorization and ledger logic of I_JournalEntryItem; the view SAP names for extracting the universal journal.

tables.key_note: The five fields that are ACDOCA's key without the client. Not verified: the view's own key may differ by release.
tables.note: Amounts are signed. Filter on one ledger before summing. The same rows as I_JournalEntryItem: land one of them.

traps.title: One line per ledger in I_JournalEntryItem
traps.text: The universal journal holds every posting once per ledger, and Ledger is part of the key of I_JournalEntryItem. A sum of AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency without a filter on one Ledger counts each posting once per ledger. The amounts are signed: debit positive, credit negative, so a whole document sums to zero.

traps.title: Three amounts, three currencies
traps.text: A journal line carries its amount in the transaction currency (AmountInTransactionCurrency, TransactionCurrency), the company code currency (AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency, CompanyCodeCurrency) and the global currency (AmountInGlobalCurrency, GlobalCurrency). Only the company code amount can be added within a company code without converting; the transaction amount differs from document to document.
